lines.COREPROF: appends other_ms window_ms ppu/spu/rsx/jit/other_cores compile_threads compile_cores other_threads rsx_fifo_busy rsx_thread_cpu top=<five busiest threads>; emitted in windows without a presented frame unless the emulator is stopped

lines.NEOSTATION_RESTART: one per internal restart, with the reason announced by the calling site (savestate_create, savestate_load, game_setting:<key>, home_menu, sys_game, other)
lines.JITPROF_BOOT: two lines per ppu_initialize(): boot kind, modules total/compiled/cached/existing, PPU cache hits/misses, wall time, the nine boot-scoped PPU phases, headroom and pipeline tail; then part=spu with the six SPU phases (split so each line stays under the host 1 KiB milestone cut; monotonic totals added to Utilities/JITPhaseProfile.h; the 5 s reporter keeps its exchanged window)
lines.SAVESTATE_BOOT: two lines on a state-load boot: applied_patches, seg0_code_end, functions, fragments; then cache hits/misses, objects loaded, link time, total fragments
lines.FREEZE_DUMP: bounded dump (64 lines, one per 30 s) of PPU/SPU/RSX thread states when no frame was presented for more than 3 s while a thread group used more than 0.5 core and the emulator was running; idm and SPU group locks only tried, the dump is skipped and counted when busy
lines.MUTEX_DESTROY_BUSY: sys_mutex_destroy CELL_EBUSY: mutex, owner and caller ids and names; first 64 per process, then one per 1024 calls with suppressed=
